content: Stack Exchange API has /questions/no-answers and /questions/unanswered; allowed sorts are activity, votes, creation — there is NO sort-by-views server-side. Question objects include view_count in the default filter, so 'high-view unanswered' = fetch a window (sorted by votes or creation, tagged) and rank by view_count client-side. /search/advanced adds answers=0 and accepted=False params.
